text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 reads `_meta.claudeCode.options` on `session/new` and spreads it into the Agent SDK `query()` options. It ignores `cwd`, `permissionMode`, `canUseTool`, `executable` and `includePartialMessages`. It merges `hooks`, `mcpServers` and `disallowedTools` with its own. `settings` takes a path or an inline object, and `plugins` loads skills from a plugin folder. Source: `NewSessionMeta` in the adapter's `src/acp-agent.ts`.
